_comment: ClawHub takes categories and topics as publish-time flags, not frontmatter. A skill
published without --categories is classified by the registry, which is how these
landed in 'other', 'development' and 'integrations' with no pattern to it. Omitting
the flag on a later publish keeps whatever the registry already decided, so every
skill is listed here explicitly, including the ones that happen to be right.
Categories: at most 3, from integrations, automation, research, development,
productivity, communication, creative, knowledge, agents, operations, security,
finance, lifestyle, other. An unknown slug fails the publish. Topics: at most 5 free
labels, 48 characters each; official, verified and certified are reserved.
